coder_notes: Season 18 is an anthology: Alexis (E1); the doula-fraud cluster (E2-E8: Karissa, Seanna, Amy W., Amy S., Audrey and other doulas); Gaby (E9); Chris Williams (E10); Tyler/Shane (E11-12); Jimmy/Andrew/Anthony (E13-14); Autumn (E15). All 8 chunk files were read in full to their stated last lines. INDEX.txt was read; three thematically possible unassigned episodes were opened and read in full, and none continues an S18 story. Judgment calls: (1) For doulas, 'protected' rests on the perpetrator's March 2023 arrest and continued custody (removal of access). No conviction is reported, and several doulas say jail does not help them. (2) Who was decisive in the doula arrest is disputed between narrators: Seanna and Amy S. credit the viral TikToks; Audrey credits the doulas who pressed police for an investigation; police had already summoned the perpetrator before the weekend of the viral posts. Each record follows that person's own account. (3) Borderline 'harm' records are included and flagged low confidence: Chris Williams (ghosting; police contact was a welfare check on the woman), Andrew and Anthony (band leader's emotional abuse and threats in texts), the Tyler bus-crash record, and a collective record for the anonymous group of women. (4) Perpetrator and non-victim names are replaced with [perpetrator] or role descriptions in quotes. Two doulas are named as the show names them (Katie Nelson in source notes; Ashley Palmer in news audio). (5) Gaby's harmed_by_institution_ever=true rests on her abuser's release without notice. Jimmy's and Parker's rest on a court restraining order and an arrest warrant issued against them, although their own harms never reached an institution.
